title: A Archive for the Horizon
author: Zephyrine Sandoval
blurb: Juniper Zhou, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
